name: AfroCentric Investment Corporation Limited
source: CRON 20261122: added H1 2026 and H1 2025 (re-presented) columns from the issuer interim results booklet, condensed consolidated statement of comprehensive income, R thousands converted to rands. Revenue from contracts with customers 3,485,438 (H1 2025 re-presented 3,693,642). Cost of Sales is the sum of cost of pharmaceutical goods 307,282 and cost of distribution 31,067 (H1 2025: 485,172 and 29,811), the only cost of sales lines the group reports. Operating Expenses is the residual of gross profit less operating profit, so that Revenue less Cost of Sales less Operating Expenses reproduces operating profit and operating profit less net finance costs reproduces the printed profit before tax of 111,443 (H1 2025: 88,491); it nets off dividends received, finance income, the insurance service result and the share of associates, and reconciles to the printed cost lines within 18 thousand rand, which is rounding in the issuer presentation. Net Finance Costs is interest on lease liabilities 4,904 plus finance costs 26,894. Income tax 27,729 and profit from continuing operations 83,714 both as printed. EPS is the printed basic earnings of 7.83 cents per share (H1 2025: 11.54 cents); that EPS is owners profit for the period of 65,842 including the discontinued operations loss of 12,920, while the panel Net Profit row is the continuing operations figure of 83,714. The two half-year columns are continuing operations; FY2025 and earlier in this file are as originally reported including discontinued operations, and the issuer re-presents FY2025 continuing revenue as 7,303,235. | previous source: CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies.
